title: Recheck observation workdir after owner capture when the directory disappears
outcome: An ordinary Workdir source capture whose session directory disappears or changes repositories during owner I/O cannot return an enclosing or replacement repository's source identity.
acceptance: Capture revalidates the session directory and its intended worktree at the owner-I/O boundary, failing unavailable on drift while retaining legitimate stable subdirectory captures.
A deterministic behavior regression deletes or redirects the workdir during capture, preserves a stable positive control, and proves no enclosing identity is admitted.
